title: feat: ListView grouping across all view types (Grid, Kanban, Gallery)
body:
`groupingConfig` was only wired to the Grid view. Kanban and Gallery views ignored it entirely, despite ListView already maintaining the state.

### Changes

- **GroupRow.tsx** — New standalone component extracted from inline ObjectGrid group rendering, with collapsible headers (chevron + label + count), aggregation summary display, and `aria-expanded` accessibility attribute
- **ObjectGrid.tsx** — Refactored to use the new `GroupRow` component for grouped rendering
- **ListView.tsx** — Propagate `groupingConfig` to kanban and gallery view schema construction (was only passed to grid)
- **ObjectGallery.tsx** — Implement grouped rendering with collapsible section headers, mirroring the Grid's `useGroupedData` pattern. Supports `fields[].collapsed` initial state and per-field sort order
- **ObjectKanban.tsx** — Map `grouping.fields[0].field` → `swimlaneField` fallback, reusing existing swimlane rendering. Explicit `swimlaneField` takes precedence
- **KanbanSchema (types.ts)** — Add `grouping?: GroupingConfig` to the type
- **index.tsx** (plugin-grid) — Export `GroupRow` component and `GroupRowProps` type

### Gallery grouping example

```tsx
<ObjectGallery
  schema={{
    objectName: 'products',
    grouping: {
      fields: [{ field: 'category', order: 'asc', collapsed: false }],
    },
  }}
  data={items}
/>
// Renders: [▾ Electronics (3)] [grid] / [▾ Tools (2)] [grid] / ...
```

### Tests (41 new tests)

- `useGroupedData.test.ts` — 12 tests: collapsed state management, toggleGroup, multi-field grouping, sort order, empty labels
- `GroupRow.test.tsx` — 11 tests: render, collapse/expand, aggregation summary, chevron icons, accessibility (aria-expanded)
- `GalleryGrouping.test.tsx` — 8 tests: grouped rendering, collapse/expand toggle, initial collapsed state, record counts, sort order, empty labels
- `KanbanGrouping.test.tsx` — 6 tests: swimlane mapping, explicit swimlane priority, resolution logic edge cases
- `ListViewGroupingPropagation.test.tsx` — 4 tests: verifies groupingConfig flows correctly to grid, kanban, and gallery view schemas
- All 523 existing tests across grid/list/kanban packages continue to pass
